terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the ProTip365 mobile application ("the app"). By installing or using the app, you agree to these terms.
sections: What ProTip365 is
ProTip365 is a personal record-keeping tool for scheduling shifts and tracking tips, wages, and related earnings. All records are created by you and stored on your device (see our Privacy Policy).
Not financial, tax, or legal advice

The app's calculations (including expected earnings, effective hourly rates, variances, and estimated deductions) are informational estimates based solely on the numbers you enter. They are not financial, tax, accounting, or legal advice, and they are not a substitute for professional advice or official payroll records. You are responsible for verifying any figures you rely on, including for tax-filing purposes.
License

We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the app on devices you own or control. You may not copy, modify, distribute, sell, or reverse-engineer the app except where the law permits.
Purchases

The app includes 7 days of full local access. After the trial, creating or changing records requires a one-time lifetime purchase or monthly subscription. Purchases are processed by Apple App Store or Google Play under the store's payment, renewal, cancellation, and refund terms. Monthly subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your store account. If a trial or subscription ends, existing records remain readable, exportable, backed up, and erasable. Restore Purchases restores access associated with your store account; it does not restore locally stored records.
Your data, your responsibility

Because your records are stored only on your device, you are responsible for keeping your device secure and for making backups (the app provides export tools). We cannot recover data lost through device loss, damage, deletion, or failure to back up.
Acceptable use
You agree not to use the app for unlawful purposes or attempt to interfere with its operation.
Disclaimer of warranties

The app is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the maximum extent permitted by law. We do not warrant that the app will be uninterrupted or error-free.
Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, ProTip365 will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, or for loss of data or profits, arising from your use of the app. Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the amount you paid for the app in the twelve months before the claim. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable consumer-protection law, including the laws of Québec.
Changes

We may update these terms; the "Last updated" date above will change, and material changes will be described in the app's release notes. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated terms.
Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Québec and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein, without depriving you of any mandatory consumer protections of your place of residence.
Contact
Questions about these terms: info@protip365.com. Product help is available on the support page.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what happens to your information when you use ProTip365.
sections: No account required
ProTip365 does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide an email address, password, or any other identifying credential to use the app.
Where your data lives

All information you enter into ProTip365 — including employer names, shift schedules, hours worked, tips, tip-outs, sales figures, payout details, goals, and notes — is stored in an encrypted local database on your device. ProTip365 does not upload these records to ProTip365, Supabase, a cloud-sync service, an analytics provider, or an advertising provider.
What we collect

ProTip365 does not use advertising or product-analytics services. The app may contact Apple App Store or Google Play to display prices, process purchases, and restore purchase status. It may also contact Expo's update service to check for signed app updates. Those providers may receive technical request information such as your IP address, operating-system version, store account context, or a randomized update identifier under their own policies. Employer, shift, tip, wage, goal, payout, and note contents are not included in those requests.
Exporting your data

Android version 3.0 exports CSV, PDF summaries, and readable JSON backups from Me. Choose a destination through the system share/save interface. These files contain your records and are not password-encrypted; store and share them carefully. Earlier versions use their Settings export controls.
Deleting your data

Android version 3.0 lets you erase this version’s records from Me after confirmation, with a temporary Undo option. This does not cancel purchases, restart the trial, or remove the database retained from an earlier version. Uninstalling the app removes its local storage. Export records you need first. There is no cloud account or server copy to delete.
Purchases

If you purchase a lifetime unlock or monthly subscription, the transaction is processed by Apple App Store or Google Play. The store returns purchase status to the app on your device so ProTip365 can grant or restore access. ProTip365 does not operate a receipt server and does not receive your payment-card details or billing address.
Security, backups, and notifications

SQLCipher encrypts the local database; its random key is stored in the operating system keystore or keychain. Android version 3.0 preserves an existing app passcode, recovery key, and biometric configuration when upgrading from an earlier version. It does not currently offer new lock setup. Its JSON backups are readable, not password-encrypted. Earlier versions offer password-encrypted .pt365 backups. Optional post-shift reminders are scheduled locally.
Children
ProTip365 is intended for general audiences of working adults and is not directed at children.
Changes to this policy
If this policy changes, the "Last updated" date above will change, and material changes affecting how your data is handled will be described in the app's release notes.
Contact

Questions about this policy or ProTip365's data practices can be sent to info@protip365.com. Information you choose to include in a support email is processed only to answer your request. See the support page for self-service help.
Website and interactive demo

The website stores your selected language in your browser’s local storage. The interactive web demo uses sample records that reset when it reloads; it is not your mobile-app account or a cloud backup. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts and is hosted on Vercel, so these providers receive requests needed to serve the site, including technical information such as your IP address. Do not use the demo to store sensitive earnings records.

support.intro: For help with ProTip365, email info@protip365.com. Include your app version, device model, operating-system version, and the steps that led to the issue. Do not email employer names, shift notes, earnings records, backup passwords, purchase receipts, or other sensitive information.
sections: Where are my records?

Your employers, shifts, tips, wages, goals, and settings are stored only in the encrypted ProTip365 database on your device. There is no account or cloud sync. Reinstalling the app or losing the device may lose records that you have not exported or backed up.
How do I make or restore a backup?

In Android version 3.0, open Me and save a JSON backup. To restore, select a valid JSON backup and confirm; the app first offers a backup of your current records. Backup restore and exports remain available after trial or paid access ends. JSON files are readable and are not password-encrypted. Earlier versions use Settings → Encrypted backup & restore and password-protected .pt365 files; that format cannot currently be restored through the version 3.0 JSON picker.
How do purchases work?

Android version 3.0 provides seven days of local trial access. Open the access options in Me for store-supplied prices or Restore Purchases. Use the store account that bought the app. Restoring purchases restores access, not local records. Monthly subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in the store.
My subscription ended

Your records remain readable, exportable, backed up, and erasable. Creating or changing records requires an active monthly subscription or lifetime unlock. Subscription cancellation and refund requests are managed by the store where you purchased.
Passcode or biometric trouble

An existing lock from an earlier Android version is preserved during upgrade. Use your six-digit app passcode, saved recovery key, or previously enabled biometrics. Your device passcode does not replace the app passcode. Version 3.0 does not offer new lock setup. Support cannot bypass a lock or recover a missing local encryption key.
Erase local data

In Android version 3.0, Me → Erase this version’s records requires confirmation and briefly offers Undo. Purchases, the trial start, and the retained earlier-version database remain. Save a JSON backup first if you may need these records later. Earlier versions have different erase controls.
